data.gender_notes: Lokita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lokita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'loka' meaning 'people'. The name signifies the goddess who protects and nurtures her people. In Hindu mythology, Lokita is a form of the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. She is believed to bring happiness and good fortune to her devotees. The name Lokita carries the meaning “Goddess of the people” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lokita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
